episodes.synopsis: The Fei Xin Force is sent out to join forces with General Huan Yi to conquer Heiyong in Zhao, but their opponent--and the terrain--won't make it easy.
episodes.title: Monsters Take the Field

episodes.synopsis: As the fighting gets underway in Heiyong, Qiang Lei's scouts make a disturbing discovery, Xin goes for broke, and Huan Yi brings out the big guns.
episodes.title: The Stench of the Battlefield

episodes.synopsis: Tactician He Liao Diao racks her brains to find some way out of an impossible situation so the Fei Xin Force can complete their mission-critical task.
episodes.title: A Lieutenant's Responsibility

episodes.synopsis: Lieutenant Yuan and his men work hard to fulfill their vital role. A surprise appearance by a charismatic figure greatly affects the tides of battle.
episodes.title: A Determined Crossing

episodes.synopsis: He Liao Diao switches gears to share some hard-earned power with Huan Yi's forces--all the general has to do is take it. Qiang Lei's caretaker speaks.
episodes.title: Heiyong's Crucial Moment

episodes.synopsis: Qiang Lei learns about Ji Hui's background. Frustration mounts in the face of Huan Yi's inaction. Qing She decides to take matters into his own hands.
episodes.title: The Tragedy of Liyǎn

episodes.synopsis: The Battle of Heiyong reaches a fever pitch as Huan Yi's men target Qing She--who in turn is looking to slay Xin. Xin comes up with an audacious plan.
episodes.title: In an Instant

episodes.synopsis: Qing She considers his debt to Li Mu as he faces Xin on the battlefield. Devastating events drive Ji Hui to pursue a new tactic in defending Heiyong.
episodes.title: Misfortune

episodes.synopsis: Huan Yi's top commanders question his latest bizarre decision. Wei Ping has a crisis of conscience. Xin and Qiang Lei react to a gruesome discovery.
episodes.title: Roar of Pride

episodes.synopsis: The standoff with Huan Yi continues until Wei Ping intervenes, but Xin learns a disappointing fact that paints his loyal friend in a whole new light.
episodes.title: Wei Ping and the Fei Xin Force

episodes.synopsis: General Huan Yi shows that his cutthroat reputation is well deserved as he tightens the screws on Ji Hui and forces him to make an agonizing decision.
episodes.title: The Small Hours Before a Showdown

episodes.synopsis: Cai Ze returns to Xianyang with not one, but two unexpected guests. Zheng is put on the spot about his plans for a post-unified Middle Kingdom world.
episodes.title: Cai Ze's Honor
